notes.title: The Shattering DLC is out!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/IPfsv5n.gif[/img]

We are happy to announce the release of the [b]Secret Room[/b], our [b]free DLC[/b] for The Shattering!

After finishing the main game, you will find an option in the main menu to play the DLC. This will lead you to a scene where you can choose to replay any of the acts, or open the Secret Door and explore what's inside! 

Also because this is our [b]1st Year Release Anniversary[/b], The Shattering will be on a [b]50% discount[/b] for the whole week!
[hr][/hr]
This DLC update, comes also with changes to the main game:
[list] - general fixes and tweaks 
- optimizations
- option to turn on-off the subtitles
- Simplified Chinese localization [/list]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1542030/The_Shattering__Secret_Room/

[previewyoutube=ZPstK3mnwbY;full][/previewyoutube]

tags.feature: - option to turn on-off the subtitles

notes.title: Update 1.1.8 - Secret Room DLC, Simplified Chinese and Subtitles!
notes.content:
1.1.8 is shipping to celebrate our 1-year anniversary! 

[previewyoutube=2VV3NRVJFAo;full][/previewyoutube]

Detailed notes for the anniversary patch:

- Secret Room DLC! Make sure to install it from Steam when it is officially launched. The Secret Room is unlocked after beating the game at least once on the signed-in account. It contains some heartfelt commentary from the developers, new gameplay with parts of the game that weren't in the final shipped version, and more. There are 6 Developer Commentaries to listen to, try to find them all!
- Subtitles on/off option added (yes, this one is for you Catman)
- Simplified Chinese localization
- Small tweaks and some performance fixes in the rest of the game

Please let us know if you run into any problems in the forums, on our Discord, or mail us... we're here!

notes.title: The Shattering Secret Room coming out soon!
notes.content:
The Shattering is about to have its [b]1st Year Release Anniversary[/b] and because of this special occasion we are happy to announce[b] The Secret Room[/b]. A [b]free DLC[/b] for the main game.

After finishing the main story, you will be able to unlock a secret door that will lead you to a place filled with wonders and surprises.

[b]This DLC comes with:[/b]
[list]
[*]Unlocking the last door in the Corridor with new game content
[*]Detailed environment to explore
[*]Objects and Scenes that were not used in the main game
[*]Developer commentary
[*]Option to replay individual Acts of the main story
[/list]
[i]*Playing this DLC requires finishing the main story first.[/i]

[h3]Also for a whole week from the release The Shattering will be on a [b]50% discount![/b][/h3]

[h3]Release date:[b] 21st of April 2021[/b][/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1542030/The_Shattering__Secret_Room/

[previewyoutube=G7K0hdna9EQ;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: 1.0.3 PATCH - Visual tweaks and fixes
notes.content:
Dear The Shattering fans,

We worked on some feedback of yours and are releasing a new patch (1.0.3) to fix some minor issues throughout the game:

- updating and fixing quality of some textures 
- fixed the hints positions
- fixed collisions with some objects
- fixed clipping of some models
- updating Polish translations
- tweaked animations
- tweaked timing of some events and narrations
- tweaked some save points states

Please let us know on the forums if you are having any issues!
